summary: All keyboard-preview user content (keyboardText and every button label) is rendered exclusively via {{ }} mustache interpolation — Vue's escaped text binding. Zero v-html directives exist in FunnelCanvasNode.vue or the canvas client component. The only :src binding in the file is previewThumbUrl, which is gated by a strict HTTP_URL_RE = /^https?:\/\//i scheme guard that rejects javascript:, data:, file://, and opaque tokens — keyboard nodes carry no media block so this path is never reached for SET_KEYBOARD/CLEAR_KEYBOARD content. Truncation operates on plain strings via String.slice() before the value is handed to the template, preserving Vue's normal escaping. The injection-payload test (FunnelCanvas.spec.ts:966) is load-bearing: it feeds as both keyboardText and a button label and asserts no /]*onerror/i match, entity-encoded <img present, and zero real elements — all three assertions guard against stored-XSS materialization. No unsafe sinks (:href, :style, innerHTML, document.write) are present in any code path introduced by this commit.
